outcome: Success rate of trial of labor after Cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Pregnant women with one previous lower segment Cesarean section who presented in spontaneous labor and consented to TOLAC at a tertiary care center
finding: Success of TOLAC was significantly associated with younger maternal age, previous vaginal delivery, lower pre-pregnancy BMI, lower estimated fetal birth weight, and a higher Bishop score.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal birth weight was measured
